maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from NERLYNX, a cancer drug sold for new patient treatment, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: NERLYNX is paid mostly by commercial insurers and private payers via specialty pharmacies; government share is not clearly the majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own NERLYNX sales and drug development; in-licenses a few drug candidates rather than acquiring companies regularly.

mission_critical.reason: NERLYNX is a prescription oncology drug; physicians can switch to other HER2 therapies, though clinical considerations apply.

notes: Payer mix for NERLYNX (government versus commercial) is not on the website; publicly_funded and mission_critical are judgement calls.
